title: GenericDungeon
goal: Port GenericDungeon (7111 lines, verhalten/world-01.md) onto the structure infrastructure from W12 (src/main/java/com/swbr/orespawn/world/structure/): every make*/add* method becomes a Structure/StructurePiece (or a Feature when the footprint fits the 3x3-chunk window) whose postProcess writes only inside its BoundingBox through the W12 clipped writer, with block states converted by the W12 metadata helper, chest loot through the W12 loot filler, spawners with their original mobs, and placement per dimension as OreSpawnWorld called them (structure sets, spacing/separation replacing recently_placed, seeded randomness per R18). Original bugs in positions, casts and palettes stay (R18: addD4WhiteHouse z<300, piston_extension -> moving_piston, lit_redstone_lamp). The three porters split the source file by line ranges; each ports every method whose body STARTS in its range, and shared private helpers of GenericDungeon go to w13-dungeon-a (the others call them by name in com.swbr.orespawn.world.dungeon.GenericDungeonHelpers). Close every 'TODO W13' back-edge in OreSpawnWorld and items through registry_entries. Read docs/port/W12.md first: the structure infrastructure (world/structure/StructureWriter, LegacyMeta, chest filler, the 45 placeholder builder ids orespawn:make_* registered with // PORT: TODO W13 and their boxes) already exists - replace each placeholder with the real builder, keep ids and structure sets. W09-W11 entities do not exist yet: spawner mob ids stay registry id strings and a missing type leaves an empty spawner (W12 convention), marked // PORT: TODO W09/W10/W11. The shared writer is changed first by w13-writer (DECISIONS R23) - builders written in parallel use the StructureWriter API as it is today; the change must keep that API.

workers.task: Implement DECISIONS R23 (seamless structure writer) in world/structure/: a structure builds once per start in full (recorded write log with the exact read results and random draws the original run saw), and each chunk postProcess only replays the log clipped to its BoundingBox, so reads and chest rolls never depend on the chunk being generated. Keep the public StructureWriter API the builders use (setBlock, getBlock, setChest/fillChest, spawner) unchanged. Also write the catalogue 4.13 GameTests W12 did not write, in gametest/W13WriterGameTests.java: one W12 structure and one tree built across a 3x3 chunk field has no seam (identical blocks to a single unclipped run) and writes only inside its BoundingBox; ore veins with LessOre; the config_spawns enable flag.
Port the methods of GenericDungeon.java whose bodies start on lines 1-2400, plus every shared private helper of the class (into GenericDungeonHelpers).
owns: structure JSON and structure_set files for the structures of this range under src/main/resources/data/orespawn/worldgen/

workers.task: Port the methods of GenericDungeon.java whose bodies start on lines 2401-4800 (not the shared helpers - call them in GenericDungeonHelpers).
owns: structure JSON and structure_set files for the structures of this range

workers.task: Port the methods of GenericDungeon.java whose bodies start on lines 4801-7111, including addLevelDecorations(Q) with the Nastysaurus critter branch (catalogue 6.5), makeEnderDragonHospital, makeShadowDungeon, makeHauntedHouse, makeIgloo if they are in this range (not the shared helpers).
owns: structure JSON and structure_set files for the structures of this range

gametests: every GenericDungeon structure is placed once in a test world through its Structure/Feature and writes only inside its BoundingBox; a sample of five structures (one challenge dungeon, Inca Pyramid, Robot Lab, White House, Cloud Shark Dungeon) contains its spawners with the original mob ids and its chests with loot; no 'TODO W13' remains; the dedicated server starts and generates spawn chunks in the Overworld and all six dimensions without 'Detected setBlock in a far chunk'; all earlier tests still pass.
